ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Jew 365 uses your location to calculate halachic times, such as sunrise and candle lighting, where you are, and to point the prayer compass to Jerusalem. You can also choose a place by hand, without location.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Jew 365 uses your location only while the app is open, to calculate halachic times and point the prayer compass. You can also choose a place by hand, without location.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Jew 365 uses your location only while the app is open, to calculate halachic times and point the prayer compass. You can also choose a place by hand, without location.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Jew 365 uses Face ID only to lock the family purity tracker screens.
